Third-party code bundled with the copy4chat.com landing page.

turndown (v7.2.4) and turndown-plugin-gfm (v1.0.2)
Copyright (c) 2017 Dom Christie
MIT License — https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown

Used to convert the clipboard's text/html flavour to Markdown, which is what
a chat client actually receives from an ordinary copy and paste. Using the
recognised converter rather than a hand-written one keeps the "Regular Copy"
side of the comparison honest.
